name: ProjectIntake
title: Blocks/State/ProjectIntake
summary: The surfaces a project passes through when it is dropped on the page: the drop target (`FileDropzone` with `directories`, its title saying what dropping does and a Choose a folder `Button` as the keyboard way in), then the full-screen Initializing overlay: an `UploadProgress` card in the flow listing the received files with their status in words (Done, the percentage while uploading, Waiting), Cancel and Retry, over the upload summary. A large drop lists only the files still moving (at most 50 rows) while the heading keeps the counts. UploadFailed shows a file that failed: its row carries the reason and Retry, and a danger `Alert` above sums it up with Retry. A home page, its empty state, a creation hub and a project detail page render the drop target (the project page swaps the copy for “We build a new version of web-app, then you choose where it goes live.”); the home page, its empty state and the creation hub render Initializing over themselves. DropZone is a page body inside the default slot of ConsoleLayout; Initializing covers the whole screen.

variants.name: Initializing
variants.summary: The Initializing overlay mid-upload, held inside a layout-contained frame here so it does not cover the docs page: two files uploaded, the third uploading, two queued, in an `UploadProgress` card with each file's status in words, Cancel and the summary.

variants.name: UploadFailed
variants.summary: A file fails mid-upload: its `UploadProgress` row shows the reason and Retry, a danger `Alert` above the card says one file could not be uploaded with Retry, and the rest keep going.
